prompts.concept: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a new sculptable rock master for an ancient-Chinese fantasy game; a single connected cliff-edge section, NOT an island scene or a row of placed rocks. Input image 1 is a style/form reference only; do not copy its vegetation, architecture, ground layout or background. Create a clean 3D clay sculpt concept of ONE substantial asymmetrical geological mass, roughly 5.5m wide, 4m high, 3m deep. One broad dominant oblique face wraps diagonally from an unequal high left rear shoulder toward the lower middle; it changes facing direction across a firm large ridge. A smaller recessed right shoulder and a low left ledge interlock with it. Two irregular clefts terminate inside the mass rather than slicing full-height columns. The whole lower third eases inward into ONE calm broad faceted basal return, joining all upper masses: no individual hanging feet, no separate base slab, no pedestal, no flat horizontally sawn bottom, no pointed crystal. Top has an uneven broken rock bench, with usable broad rear top surfaces and varied shoulders meeting an eventual separately authored soil/grass layer. No grass, soil cap, plants, vines, debris, scattered stones or added props in this asset. Broad, confident, softly weathered planes and firm geological turns, restrained small chips, very little tiny noise. Avoid three equal pillars, cylindrical columns, stacked masonry courses, vertical wall rectangles, razor thin fins and mechanical bevel bands. Entire closed rock object alone, centered with generous margins, neutral light grey matte clay, soft studio lighting showing form without painted texture. Plain clean off-white background with only a faint contact shadow, no scene, no labels or collage. Front-right three-quarter orthographic product view, camera about 15 degrees above horizontal, showing real depth and the continuous inward lower return. Deliberate game-ready stylization, flowing Chinese-fantasy silhouette like the rock structure of the reference, not a photogrammetry rubble pile.
prompts.front: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: FRONT image for one four-view Tripo reconstruction task. Input image 1 is the approved identity anchor for this single connected cliff rock. Change ONLY the viewing direction to a TRUE STRAIGHT FRONT ORTHOGRAPHIC view facing the broad exposed geological face, camera horizontal at the object's midheight. This is one image of one object, not a collage, turnaround sheet, cutaway or mirrored duplicate. Preserve the SAME asymmetrical rock: high unequal left shoulder, broad central oblique rock plane with a major turn and terminating clefts, lower right shoulder, small left projecting ledge, all joined into the SAME substantial continuous inward-tapering lower rock mass. Same connected base, same relative proportions and major fissures; do not turn it into upright cylinders or separate columns, masonry blocks or a thin wall. Preserve its actual depth even though this view projects it. Rock only, no ground plane geometry, grass, dirt, vines, plants or props. Neutral pale grey untextured clay, clearly readable broad planes with restrained minor chips, soft neutral studio illumination; clean off-white background, faint shadow only. Entire object centered and uncropped, 8 percent safe margin, consistent scale with other eventual views. No text, border, diagrams or labels. Preserve the concept's main shape; do not invent a different rock design.
prompts.left: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: LEFT SIDE image for one multi-view rock reconstruction. Image1 is the FRONT identity view; image2 is the same object's three-quarter concept showing depth. Render that SAME rock, change ONLY camera to its TRUE LEFT SIDE orthographic view, camera at negative worldX looking toward positiveX; front of object (world+Z, the big cliff face in image1) is toward SCREEN RIGHT, back is toward SCREEN LEFT. This must be a narrow side/depth profile, not the wide front face rotated slightly. Its full front width is5.5units, height4units, depth3units, so side silhouette is roughly3wide by4high. Preserve the high left geological shoulder and its low projecting front-left ledge, with the broad cliff face bending inward to the SAME common thick rounded/faceted basal return. Back rises toward the higher rear ridge; front ledge projects screen-right from the middle-upper left shoulder. Do not invent detached boulders or a separate pedestal, cylindrical pillars, masonry courses, a flat sawcut foot or razor fins. Close the back with substantial rock volume. The dominant front central face is mostly occluded from this side. Keep believable consistent profiles for an eventual opposite right view: frontward protrusions at screen-right here must be screen-left in that opposite view. Preserve asymmetry and distinctive shoulder/ledge identity. Pale matte grey untextured clay, soft neutral studio light, clean off-white background, faint shadow only. One centered entire object, uncropped, same ground height and image vertical scale as image1 with room on all sides. No grass/soil/plants/props, text, diagrams, collage, borders or labels. This is a separate single left-view input file, not a turnaround sheet.
prompts.right: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: RIGHT SIDE single input for one four-view rock reconstruction. Image1 FRONT, image2 LEFT SIDE and image3 three-quarter concept all depict the same connected rock. Change ONLY camera to TRUE RIGHT SIDE orthographic: camera at positive worldX looking toward negativeX, so the FRONT exposed cliff side (+Z) is toward SCREEN LEFT and BACK is SCREEN RIGHT. The outer side silhouette should correspond to the opposite-handed LEFT profile in image2, but show the genuinely opposite rock surface, not a horizontally flipped photograph of that left face. This is a depth profile roughly3units wide by4units high, not the wide5.5unit front facade. Tall rear ridge/crest toward SCREEN RIGHT, forward shoulder and left-side ledge projecting toward SCREEN LEFT (may be partly hidden by the nearer low right shoulder). Keep the front high-left/low-right asymmetry of image1, substantial depth, same enclosing common lower mass with a continuous inward basal return and no individual hanging pillar feet. Clefts terminate; no disconnected rocks, pedestal, flat sawcut base, mechanical courses or thin fins. Backside is quieter continuous rock, all part of this one object. Neutral pale matte clay and soft studio light on clean off-white backdrop, faint shadow only; same vertical scale/ground height as other inputs, entire object centered with margins. No plants/grass/dirt, extra props, text, labels, collage, multiple views or cutaway. Preserve object identity and major geological planes; only rotate the camera.
prompts.back: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: BACK single image for one four-view Tripo task. Image1 is the FRONT identity anchor, image2 the LEFT profile, image3 the three-quarter concept of one connected cliff rock. Show that SAME object from its TRUE STRAIGHT BACK orthographic direction, camera horizontal at midheight; NOT a mirrored front facade. The high shoulder that appears at FRONT SCREEN LEFT in image1 now appears at BACK SCREEN RIGHT; the lower front-right shoulder is on BACK SCREEN LEFT. Preserve the SAME total width5.5,height4,depth3, stepped/sloping upper silhouette, enclosing side profiles, broad shared inward-returning lower mass. Show the back's substantial quiet connected rock surfaces with a few broad interlocking oblique planes and terminating clefts, less deeply articulated than the front; do not reproduce the front's exposed large central face or its protruding front ledge as a new back ledge. The actual far-side front ledge can be hidden behind the back body. No detached boulders, separate columns/feet, pedestal, flat sawcut bottom, razor fins or masonry grid. Rock only, no ground geometry/grass/soil/vines/plants or other props. Pale grey matte untextured clay, restrained minor chips, soft neutral studio lighting, clean off-white background, faint shadow. Entire object uncropped, centered with margins, same vertical scale and ground height as other views. Single back-view file, no labels/text/borders/collage/turnaround sheet. Change camera only, preserve all shared proportions and identity.
